decision.observation: The farmer is south of the farmhouse at 8:40 a.m.; a shrub immediately east blocks the lower route, while the path beside the house is clear.
decision.hypothesis: Moving north first will reach the clear upper path leading east toward the bus stop and Pelican Town.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. From the farm, use the clear path north of the shrub to go east through the bus stop into Pelican Town, then turn south rather than continuing to the eastern riverbank. Passing out costs money.
